title: Personio position row
description: One open position from a public Personio board, read from the employer's own XML feed.

status.title: Status
status.description: DELIVERED, NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_NOT_FOUND, NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_EMPTY, NOT_CHECKED_NO_MATCH, NOT_CHECKED_CAP, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR or INVALID_INPUT.

board.title: Board identifier
board.description: Personio company name, as used in <board>.jobs.personio.de.

subcompany.title: Company unit
subcompany.description: Legal unit the employer filed the position under, for example a national subsidiary.

department.title: Department
department.description: Department as published by the employer.

recruitingCategory.title: Recruiting category
recruitingCategory.description: Category the employer picked, for example insurance or engineering.

occupation.title: Occupation
occupation.description: Personio occupation code, for example acturial_analysis.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: The employer's own keyword list, split on commas.

locations.title: All offices
locations.description: Every office of the position, the main one first, each as {"city": name}.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: True when the office name or the description says remote or homeoffice. The feed has no remote flag, so this is read from the employer's text and is not a guarantee. The description is read even when includeDetails is off, so a display option does not change the value. Null on rows that are not a position.

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: Creation date as published (ISO 8601 with offset).

applyUrl.title: Apply URL
applyUrl.description: Application page. Personio serves the form from the same address as the position page.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description when includeDetails is on: html or plain text depending on descriptionFormat.

descriptionSections.title: Description sections
descriptionSections.description: The sections the employer wrote, as a list of {name, value}, when includeDetails is on. Keeps headings such as team, tasks and benefits separable.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Human readable reason for any row that is not DELIVERED.

billable.title: Billable
billable.description: What the price list said before the row was written: true when it carries this event, false when billing is off, null when the price could not be read. The money actually taken is chargedEvents in the run summary; a row can land uncharged and is then counted in deliveredUncharged.
